property: After a timed-out attempt the process must end on its own: the caller's lease timer must not be re-ref'd by an aborted AbortSignal.any composite.
exitIsMeasuredByTheCaller: This script cannot time its own exit. tests/tts_hardening_test.ts runs the same shape as a child and fails if it has not exited within 15s; on the pre-fix code that child was killed at 20s (measured).

mechanism.observation: A bare AbortSignal.timeout does not hold the loop open; the same timer does once the AbortSignal.any composite around it has aborted. Recorded, not asserted: it is Deno's behaviour, not this repo's, and a future runtime may change it.

compositeAfterAbort.code: const any = AbortSignal.any([AbortSignal.timeout(600_000), AbortSignal.timeout(100)]); any.addEventListener("abort", () => console.log("aborted")); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); console.log("work done");
